_comment: Security policy for the BFF. Single source of truth for both the server-side enforcement (route handlers, middleware) and the client-side idle countdown, so the two can never drift. Values are in seconds. Changing them requires a rebuild — they are policy, not per-environment configuration.

rateLimits._comment: Fixed-window, per client IP. Stops abuse one hop before the backend (oan_auth_service) and the OpenG2P IAM service.

session._comment: maxAge values mirror the backend refresh-token expiry (oan_auth_service refresh_token_ttl / jwt_refresh_token_ttl) so a cookie never outlives the token it carries. idleTimeout is enforced independently of both.
